highlights.title: Bots show what they did
highlights.text: Ask to see something and the bot shares the picture in the chat, under its reply. A change you can see gets a before and an after picture.

highlights.title: With approvals off, bots just do it
highlights.text: Your approvals setting now reaches every engine. With it off, bots do the work instead of offering it, look before they ask, and ask one thing at a time.

highlights.title: Drag files onto any chat
highlights.text: Drop files anywhere on a chat, in the web app or the desktop apps. Before you let go it says which bot gets them and what can't be sent.

highlights.title: Bring your bots from more places
highlights.text: Import OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Codex, Paperclip and ai-employees setups, from a folder, a public GitHub repo or what kwant finds on this computer.

highlights.title: Checked with fresh eyes
highlights.text: Dev mode reviews now start with no chat history, and a pre-push card checks a bot's push for secrets, new packages and weakened tests first.

highlights.title: Protect your keys from tricked Claude bots
highlights.text: Run Claude inside the VM has a clearer name. With it on, a page, file or bot that tricks Claude can't make it read your sign-ins or keys. Linux, VM mode, off by default.

fixes: A second message to a busy bot now waits its turn, with a line under the running reply.
A short follow-up like "show me" keeps the effort of the work it continues. A stalled reply is retried once.
The working line now sits just above the message box.
On a Mac, Claude can't read your sign-in folders or kwant's secrets.
A bot's Enter key now submits forms and search boxes.
kwant's own browser now works on Windows and Linux ARM too.
Deleting a bot no longer fails with "database error".
Undo of a ready-made team or an import works again when search is out of step.
